name: Wittenberg University
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts university (founded 1845), affiliated with the ELCA. ~1,285 students (1,227 undergraduate), 12:1 student-faculty ratio, average class size 18. Offers 70+ majors and special programs. Member of the Annapolis Group; recognized in Princeton Review's Best 384 Colleges and Forbes' America's Top Colleges. Note: the Higher Learning Commission placed Wittenberg on probation in November 2025 over financial management concerns.
financial_aid: More than 98% of Wittenberg students receive financial aid or scholarships. The university grants more than $40 million in scholarship and financial assistance annually. As an NCAA Division III institution, Wittenberg does NOT offer athletic scholarships; aid is need- and merit-based only. Full 2026-27 cost of attendance (tuition $47,000 + room/board/fees) totals $60,798/year. (Source: wittenberg.edu/administration/sfs/student-expenses, checked 2026-07.)
facilities_notes: Softball plays home games at the Bartow Softball Complex on the Wittenberg campus (250 Bill Edwards Dr., Springfield, OH 45503).
program_reputation: Established NCAC program; Ashley Goodwin is the 10th head coach in program history. Under Goodwin the Tigers went 21-21 (2023-24), advanced to the NCAC Tournament as a No. 4 seed in 2024 and 2025 (27-14 in 2025), and in 2026 earned a share of the NCAC regular-season title, finishing 27-17 after losing the NCAC Tournament championship game to Denison.
